/* selectSrvcExcnBizCombo - Lee SangHoon */
SELECT DISTINCT
B.BIZ_YR AS BIZ_YR, /* 사업연도 */ A.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO AS SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO, /* 서비스실행사업번호 */ A.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NM AS SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NM /* 서비스실행사업명 */
FROM SDA420 A /* 서비스실행사업 */ LEFT JOIN SDA400 B /* 서비스사업 */ ON A.SRVC_BIZ_NO = B.SRVC_BIZ_NO
WHERE 1=1 AND B.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} AND (A.EXCN_BIZ_CL_SE_CD != '02' OR A.EXCN_BIZ_CL_SE_CD IS NULL)
ORDER BY A.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NM

/* selectInstNmCombo - Lee SangHoon */
SELECT A.INST_NO AS INST_NO ,A.INST_NM AS INST_NM ,MAX(SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH(A.BIZ_YR,'|')) AS BIZ_YR ,MAX(SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH(A.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO,'|')) AS SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO ,'Y' AS FILTER FROM (SELECT A.INST_NO AS INST_NO /* 기관번호 */ ,A.INST_NM AS INST_NM /* 기관명 */ ,B.BIZ_YR AS BIZ_YR /* 사업연도 */ ,B.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO AS SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO /* 서비스실행사업번호*/ ,(ROW_NUMBER () OVER(PARTITION BY A.INST_NO ORDER BY A.INST_NO, B.BIZ_YR, B.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO )) RNUM FROM SAA000 A /* 통합기관 */
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT T1.BIZ_YR , T2.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO , T3.RSFR_INST_NO FROM SDA400 T1 JOIN SDA420 T2 ON T2.SRVC_BIZ_NO = T1.SRVC_BIZ_NO JOIN SDA100 T3 ON T3.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = T2.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO WHERE T3.APRV_STTS_SE_CD = '2' ) B ON B.RSFR_INST_NO = A.INST_NO
WHERE 1=1 AND (A.INST_NO = #{INST_NO} OR #{INST_TYPE_SE_CD} != '8') AND A.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} AND A.DEL_YN != 'Y' AND A.APRV_YN = 'Y' AND A.INST_TYPE_SE_CD = '8') A START WITH A.RNUM = 1 CONNECT BY PRIOR A.RNUM = (A.RNUM - 1) AND PRIOR A.INST_NO = A.INST_NO
GROUP BY A.INST_NO, A.INST_NM
ORDER BY A.INST_NM

/* selectResrceNmCombo - Lee SangHoon */
SELECT A.RESRCE_NO AS RESRCE_NO /* 자원번호 */ , A.PVSN_RESRCE_NM AS PVSN_RESRCE_NM /* 자원제공명 */ , A.RSFR_INST_NO AS INST_NO /* 자원제공주체번호 */ , D.BIZ_YR AS BIZ_YR /* 사업연도 */ , A.SRVC_RESRCE_LCLAS_SE_CD /* 서비스자원대분류구분코드 */ , C.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO /* 서비스실행사업번호 */ , A.PVSN_BGNG_YMD /*제공시작일자*/ , A.PVSN_END_YMD /*제공종료일자*/ FROM SDA100 A /* 자원기본 */ JOIN SAA000 B /* 통합기관 */ ON A.RSFR_INST_NO LIKE B.INST_NO AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' JOIN SDA420 C ON C.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = A.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO JOIN SDA400 D ON D.SRVC_BIZ_NO = C.SRVC_BIZ_NO
WHERE 1=1 AND (B.INST_NO = #{INST_NO} OR #{INST_TYPE_SE_CD} != '8') AND B.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.APRV_STTS_SE_CD = '2'
ORDER BY A.PVSN_RESRCE_NM
